title: StarShoal: satellite-derived bathymetry plugin for QGIS
description: QGIS plugin for satellite-derived bathymetry (SDB) with Sentinel-2. Downloads imagery from the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem, prepares masked surface reflectance (Sen2Cor L2A or ACOLITE), applies Hedley sunglint correction and estimates shallow-water depth with Stumpf log-ratio, Lyzenga multiband and Random Forest, calibrated and validated on the same depth points with spatial blocks. Outputs depth and trust rasters plus an HTML accuracy report. Interface in Spanish and English.
